NSE IPO Anchor Book Exceeds Expectations, CEO Says

National Stock Exchange (NSE) Managing Director and CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan stated that the anchor book for the NSE's Initial Public Offering (IPO) exceeded expectations. He also indicated that the exchange intentionally left some value on the table for investors. Chauhan made these remarks in separate interviews.
